draft_en.subject: Gigabit media converters to go with the fibre you cut to length
draft_en.body:
Hello Fiber Savvy team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the bulk fibre and accessories in your shop, two small active items that sell with fibre runs:

- Industrial mini Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (SC/LC optics of your choice), DIN-rail, 12-58 V DC, model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- Compact industrial switch, 2 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, model STI-220GE - $27.8 USD EXW

FCC/CE/RoHS; neutral packing or your label; we do not supply the SFP optics themselves.

One question: which converter configuration do your customers order most with a fibre run - single-mode 20 km, multimode, or SFP-slot so they pick the optic?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
